name: BI Dashboard - Daily Ingestion, Analysis & Alerts

nodes.name: Read Google Sheet (per company)
nodes.notes: One workflow branch/execution per company. Sheet ID mapped from a lookup list of active companies (config node not shown) so new portfolio companies just need a row added to the config sheet.

nodes.name: POST /api/ingest
nodes.notes: Backend responds with ingest status PLUS anomalies/alerts created for this company in the same call, since ingest triggers detection server-side.

nodes.name: Generate AI Executive Summary
nodes.notes: Runs regardless of whether anomalies were found — the weekly/monthly digest needs a summary either way. Caching in the backend means this is a no-op cost-wise if nothing changed since the last run.
